Unauthenticated REST call, same shape as the GitHub API polling scripts/auto-update.sh already does.

Compared all 6 options. Recommendation: extend scripts/auto-update.sh's proven skeleton (poll -> build -> ctr import -> kubectl set image -> verify -> commit -> notify), swap only the build step (PaperMC API + jar download instead of git clone+Maven), run via existing user crontab. B (k8s CronJob) rejected: needs docker/podman in-pod or privileged host-mount access, would regress the deliberate minecraft-sa no-API-access design. D (Keel) and E (image watcher) rejected: no registry to watch, image is locally built. F (CI workflow) rejected: no .github/workflows exists, single-node homelab has no registry to push to anyway. C (systemd timer) rejected: no advantage over the cron pattern already used for the identical jmusicbot workload.
